items.title: Mr. Meadow: Bitcoin Deserves Better Visuals
items.summary:
Mr. Meadow is a Bitcoin artist and filmmaker in India. He prices the work in sats. The site is mrmeadow.org.
He found Bitcoin in 2017 through a friend and bought some, then spent the next years on altcoins because he could not yet tell signal from noise. He designed for a friend's wallet company, spent time at Deloitte, and worked with a Polkadot India team that was training coders in Rust and chasing funding. items.title: Benjamin Ella: Seventeen Seasons at the Royal Ballet, Then Bitcoin
items.summary:
Benjamin Ella danced seventeen seasons as a soloist of the Royal Ballet. He arrived from Melbourne at fifteen on a full scholarship, graduated with a stress fracture in the navicular, and was kept by Dame Monica Mason while two titanium pins and three hard years decided whether he would dance at all.
